changes: main calls startPwaDocumentLifetime synchronously before createRoot; late lazy PwaStatus start is idempotent and does not own bootstrap cleanup.

Document owner stops the current generation on actual pagehide, blocks late starts while suspended, and starts once on persisted pageshow. beforeunload is not used as a sticky fence, so canceled navigation preserves current ownership.
Stable stopCurrentPwa delegation plus identity-guarded cleanup handles manual clear/reprepare without stale cleanup overwriting current ownership.
Automatic and user-requested readiness use fixed SPAROWTYPE_PUBLIC_READINESS_V1 worker MessageChannel bool; unknown protocol, unavailable transport, timeout and negative answer remain unconfirmed.
Page reply endpoints are cleared/closed on reply, error, timeout, supersession or generation stop; worker closes its transferred endpoint after its waitUntil read/reply.
Latest readiness revision plus current registration/generation guards prevents old automatic/manual results from regressing newer status.

Worker uses only same-owned-cache fixed index.html and recovery CacheStorage.match reads. It accepts no path/cache arguments, reads no foreign namespace, performs no writes/fetch, and cannot recreate a concurrently deleted cache.

Manual cache deletion and fetch allowlists/cache policies remain. Manual checking guards suspended entry, and stale manual update completion returns before querying readiness after stop/supersession. Exported hasOfflineApp remains a pure legacy helper but no UI readiness path calls it.
Only synchronous native registration invocation is caught at startup to report existing offline-error state without blocking React; no global/native pageerror filtering.
